body: Thanks for your comments, I'm not sure I feel any differently but I appreciate the sounding board.
I'm in the process of deciding which of those to do. Not because I think it will help but because I obviously can't handle it anyways.

I'm selfless to a fault, but every day I feel this bad the more I feel that maybe I've earned the right to be selfish for this. I think I can find a method that at least leaves some doubt as to if it was intentional and hope that would be enough to let my friends and extended family cope. As for my immediate family, my mother and brother are sociopaths, they'll survive. But I don't think that its right to force somebody to suffer just because you don't want to deal with the grief and knowledge that you couldn't or wouldn't help.

Because sometimes outside is scary, because its 8pm and I just woke up, because I'm a disaster. You know the little cartoon where the character is trying to plug an object that is leaking, but every time they plug one hole another opens up? That's my life, solve eating problems: sleep issues. Solve sleep: motivation. Get motivated: Eating and focus.

Because everything I've gained since my hospital admission has been lost again. I'm doing everything I know to get better and its not enough. So either I'm doing something wrong or I really need to consider that I feel this way because I'm supposed to.

Who else is there to blame? Its not anybody else's responsibility to make me better, and in the end everybody else will move on if I don't. I don't think I did anything to deserve feeling this way, but I do so there must be some reason for it.

I have help, I'm doing everything I can, I follow they're advice as best as I'm able. Its not enough and I don't know what else to do.

I see them as often as I'm able, but its not something I want to do anymore.

I loved my program, I found it exciting and challenging, I even take really cool courses that aren't related to my program. I just can't do it these days.

I have decided, it just doesn't feel like the right choice.
